result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid (Dirichlet–Riemann problem): orthogonal direction-cosine transformations between coordinate systems, time derivatives of the cosines and of the rotation components p, q, r at t = 0, and auxiliary relations; the top contains an unrelated integral involving log ζ(s) (zeta function).
